_notes.what this is: A few minutes of the real thing on the Windows laptop, to see pipeline.py drive the real servers and the real train.py through all three phases. Not a training run: every phase is two or three learner updates.
_notes.how to run: .venv\Scripts\python.exe pipeline.py --config cloud\run_laptop_test.json --run-dir runs\laptop_test   (stop it with Ctrl+C, or from another terminal: pipeline.py --run-dir runs\laptop_test --stop). pipeline.py sets PYTHONUTF8=1 and PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 for the trainer itself. Watch it with: status.py --run-dir runs\laptop_test. Beside it, in a second terminal: .venv\Scripts\python.exe evaluate.py --run-dir runs\laptop_test --watch --config cloud\run_laptop_test.json
_notes.repo_dir, python: Left out: the repo is the folder pipeline.py is in and the interpreter is the one that runs pipeline.py.
_notes.servers: 2 servers on ports 8110 and 8111. NOT 8000 to 8003: those are the owner's own servers, and pipeline.py refuses a port that is already in use.
_notes.train_defaults: 32 battles; minibatch 256 with 3 accumulation steps (the laptop's 8 GB GPU cannot hold 768); an update every 4,096 decisions, the size the laptop runs in TRAINING.md were made with; a checkpoint every 2 updates.
_notes.phases: imitation 8,192 to 12,288 decisions, warmup 4,096 to 8,192, ppo 12,288. With the PSBot teacher at about 110 decisions a second and 220 after it, about five minutes plus three trainer starts.
_notes.disk: It leaves about six checkpoints of 219 MB in the run directory (roughly 1.3 GB). Nothing removes them.
_notes.retention: Off. Nothing is ever deleted on the laptop.
_notes.on_done: idle: when ppo is done the supervisor stops trainer and servers and waits to be stopped.
_notes.reporting: The speed figures in status.py come from a sample of the decision counter every 10 seconds here (30 on the box), because the whole run is minutes long.
_notes.eval: A small evaluation for evaluate.py --watch, same keys as the box's: 10 games against each of two opponents, on its own server on port 8100 (NOT the default 9000, and not a training port). every_hours 0 means every new checkpoint is evaluated as soon as the evaluation before it has finished, so a run of a few minutes gets several; poll_seconds 5 makes it look that often. Foul Play is asked for and is skipped with a note where it is not installed.
